sql.if: AND t1.colec_wrk_reg_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CollectionWorkMapperMapper.selectCollectionWork */ t1.colec_wrk_id , t1.colec_wrk_sttus_mtcd , t2.mtcd_nm AS colec_wrk_sttus_mtcd_nm , t1.colec_log_id , t1.root_medata_set_id , t1.cret_medata_set_id_list -> 'idList' AS cret_medata_set_id_list , t1.colec_wrk_msg , to_char(t1.colec_wrk_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS colec_wrk_reg_dt , to_char(t1.colec_wrk_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS colec_wrk_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_collectionwork t1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code t2 ON t2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00024' AND t2.mtcd = t1.colec_wrk_sttus_mtcd WHERE t1.colec_wrk_id = #{colecWrkId}
